name: Club Life VR
summary:
Welcome to Club Life VR — your own bar and nightclub, in virtual reality.

Pull up a stool and order from a real drinks menu, from a $2 water to a $10 cocktail, then feel the room start to sway as it hits you. Challenge the house at darts, beer pong, dice, spin-the-bottle, and coin toss — every game plays for real in-game cash, so you can win big or drink your winnings away.
